source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 习近平向印尼总统普拉博沃致慰问电
topics.official_english: Xi Jinping sends condolence message to Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto
topics.why_hot: A formal diplomatic message from China's top leader to a major Southeast Asian partner draws attention to bilateral ties and regional issues.
topics.share_angle: Explain the context of China-Indonesia relations and why such condolence messages matter in state-to-state diplomacy.

topics.chinese_topic: 天安门下半旗悼念朱镕基同志
topics.official_english: Tiananmen Square lowers flag to half-staff in mourning for Zhu Rongji
topics.why_hot: A rare national mourning display at the symbolic heart of China attracts broad public attention and reflection.
topics.share_angle: Help international viewers understand Chinese mourning protocol and the legacy of the respected former official.

topics.chinese_topic: 法拉利首款电车破纪录拍出约2.7亿元

topics.chinese_topic: 石油天然气发展“十五五”规划印发

topics.why_hot: A new five-year plan for oil and gas shapes national energy strategy, affecting prices, investment, and climate policy.
